info.title: AriesHub API
info.description: Public content catalog, Redis-backed cookie identity, flat paged discussions with comment likes, administrator content and moderation API. Credit balance lives on users and pricing on publications; the credit ledger and unlock tables exist but the credit application API is not implemented yet.
